home.title: Play from Home with Remos Pro
home.body: Look around as much as you like. Pro starts your music services, Sonos favorites and Jump Back In on your speakers with one click.

search.title: Play what you find with Remos Pro
search.body: Searching is free. Pro plays any song, album, artist or playlist from Apple Music, Spotify and your other services on your speakers.

favorites.title: Play your favorites with Remos Pro
favorites.body: Start the favorites you saved in the Sonos app, and save the song that's playing with the heart.

queue.title: Jump around the queue with Remos Pro
queue.body: Pick any song in the queue and play it right away.

sound.title: Tune your sound with Remos Pro
sound.body: Change EQ, loudness, night mode, speech enhancement, height audio, and sub and surround settings. TV Autoplay stays free.

lyrics.title: See every line with Remos Pro
lyrics.body: The full lyrics, highlighted line by line in time with the music.

gate.oneTime: One-time purchase, no subscription. Every future Pro feature included.

hint.sound: Look around freely. Changing these settings needs Remos Pro.
hint.lyrics: The full, synced lyrics are in Remos Pro.

free: Picking a room, Now Playing, play, pause, skip, volume and TV Autoplay stay free, and you can look around every Pro screen.

features.search: Play anything from Apple Music, Spotify and your other services

features.lyrics: Synced lyrics and the Up Next queue
features.sound: Sound settings: EQ, sub, surround and more
features.future: Every feature that comes next, at no extra cost

footnote: One-time purchase, no subscription. Remos relies on interfaces Sonos doesn't document, so a Sonos update can break a feature until Remos is updated.
